item.title: 📆 Top News Today Main stage of the Centre 2026 exercise is celebrated in a big way:
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 💥 Main stage of the Centre 2026 exercise is celebrated in a big way: the main stage of the strategic command post exercise Centre 2026 is taking place at the Chebarkulskiy training ground. It involves troops of the Central Military District, formations and military units of the Aerospace Forces , the Air Assault Troops and of central subordination, as well as forces of the Caspian Flotilla . The Supreme Commander-in-Chief Vladimir Putin observed the manoeuvres from the Chebarkul training ground, and Minister of Defence Andrei Belousov reported to the head of state on the progress of the final phase. 🚩 Every step makes us stronger: The Sever Group's units have established control over Grachevka, Serdobino (Kharkov region), and Malaya Rybitsa (Sumy region). ⚡️ Strike after strike: Russian troops delivered strikes at port and power infrastructure facilities of Ukraine as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU; 🔄 Sever is tightening its grip: tank crews eliminated the AFU's hardware and manpower encircled in Kharkov region. 📥 Delivering mines right under AFU's wheels : military engineers keep giving the enemy a hard time on logistics routes in Dobropolye direction. Nobody stops us! #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.description: ⚓️ The sea doesn't like weak ones. But every Russian serviceman is strong! item.title: ▫️ Preparation is over, we are ready for active phase Defence Minister Andrei Belousov reported to the Supreme Commander-in-Chief on the progress of the final stage of the Centre 2
item.description: ▫️ Preparation is over, we are ready for active phase 💬 Defence Minister Andrei Belousov reported to the Supreme Commander-in-Chief on the progress of the final stage of the Centre 2026. Comrade Supreme Commander-in-Chief, In accordance with the Training Plan of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the strategic command and post exercise Centre 2026 has been under way since 28 September. The exercise involves troops of the Central Military Region, formations and military units of the Aerospace Forces, the Airborne Troops, formations and military units of central subordination, as well as forces of the Caspian Sea Flotilla. In addition, representatives of almost 60 states and the forces and assets of the CSTO collective security system are taking part in the exercise. Seven countries have dispatched their military contingents, the defence ministry of the Congo is represented by an operational group, and 51 states are represented by observers. The total number of troops at the Chebarkulskiy training ground stands at around six thousand servicemen; around 700 pieces of hardware, more than 600 UAVs of various modifications and upwards of 60 robotic systems are being used. The training tasks are being carried out within the framework of an operation by a grouping of troops on the Central Asian strategic direction. The troops and forces have completed joint preparation and are ready for the active phase of the exercise. #Centre2026 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29772

▫️
Preparation is over, we are ready for active phase
💬
Defence Minister Andrei Belousov reported to the Supreme Commander-in-Chief on the progress of the final stage of the Centre 2026.
Comrade Supreme Commander-in-Chief,
In accordance with the Training Plan of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the strategic command and post exercise Centre 2026 has been under way since 28 September.
The exercise involves troops of the Central Military Region, formations and military units of the Aerospace Forces, the Airborne Troops, formations and military units of central subordination, as well as forces of the Caspian Sea Flotilla.
In addition, representatives of almost 60 states and the forces and assets of the CSTO collective security system are taking part in the exercise. Seven countries have dispatched their military contingents, the defence ministry of the Congo is represented by an operational group, and 51 states are represented by observers. The total number of troops at the Chebarkulskiy training ground stands at around six thousand servicemen; around 700 pieces of hardware, more than 600 UAVs of various modifications and upwards of 60 robotic systems are being used.
The training tasks are being carried out within the framework of an operation by a grouping of troops on the Central Asian strategic direction. The troops and forces have completed joint preparation and are ready for the active phase of the exercise.
#Centre2026
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
